raw_segments.text: You ask what were my exact sensations at the moment when I asked my opponent's forgiveness?"
But I had better tell you from the beginning what I have not yet told anyone else.
And I described all that had passed between a fantasy and me, and how I had bowed down
to the ground at his feet.
"'From that you can see for yourself,' I concluded, that at the time of the duel it
was easier for me, for I had made a beginning already at home, and when once I had started
on that road, to go farther along it was far from being difficult, but became a source
